title.en: Record a distribution and its per-meal menu by SMS

goal.en: DIST records meals, people and kilograms for today at the sender's site. MENU adds per-meal nutrients that the school and sodium rule packs compare with their limits.

note.en: A school program served 410 meals to 410 people from 96 kg.
Per-meal energy, sodium and fruit-and-vegetable grams for distribution D12.
PROTEIN is the fourth nutrient the grammar knows.
An incomplete DIST is a usage error.
An unknown nutrient word is a usage error, not a silent zero.

cli: cookwala sms "MENU D12 KCAL650 SODIUM540 FV95"

outcome.en: You can report a day's meals and menu from a phone. Next: scenario 072 shows which nutrients the rule packs read.
